turns.question: What was our average basket size, in euros, in the week starting Monday 21 September 2026?
turns.answer: Basket size is not a separate metric; the single definition of the average amount per order is average order value, which was 130.28 EUR for 21 to 27 September 2026 (non-cancelled orders). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
